title: Inventory job observations 0.1.0
description: Per-group samples with immutable source times, failures and model identity. Not an online health assertion.

system.system_version.description: Distribution/userland version; not equated with ietf-system os-version.

system.timezone.description: Timezone is the source abbreviation, not an IANA zone.

system.boot_time.description: Estimated controller time minus uptime; not an authoritative target boot timestamp.

hardware.vendor.description: Visible environment scope. Chassis/component identity is not assumed from whole-host DMI values.

hardware.model.description: Visible environment scope. Chassis/component identity is not assumed from whole-host DMI values.

hardware.serial.description: Visible environment scope. Chassis/component identity is not assumed from whole-host DMI values.

hardware.uuid.description: Visible environment scope. Chassis/component identity is not assumed from whole-host DMI values.

storage.filesystems.total_megabytes.description: Floor of exact source bytes / 1000000, matching integer decimal megabytes. Exact byte-valued properties remain separate to preserve precision.

storage.filesystems.used_megabytes.description: Floor of exact source bytes / 1000000, matching integer decimal megabytes. Exact byte-valued properties remain separate to preserve precision.

storage.filesystems.available_megabytes.description: Floor of exact source bytes / 1000000, matching integer decimal megabytes. Exact byte-valued properties remain separate to preserve precision.

network.interfaces.mtu.description: Source interface/address observation; link MTU is not assumed to be IP-layer MTU.

network.interfaces.address.description: Source interface/address observation; link MTU is not assumed to be IP-layer MTU.

network.interfaces.prefix_length.description: Source interface/address observation; link MTU is not assumed to be IP-layer MTU.

network.interfaces.kind.description: Source interface/address observation; link MTU is not assumed to be IP-layer MTU.

network.ipv4.address.description: Address family selected explicitly; keys identify interface and address.

network.ipv4.prefix_length.description: Address family selected explicitly; keys identify interface and address.

network.ipv6.address.description: Address family selected explicitly; keys identify interface and address.

network.ipv6.prefix_length.description: Address family selected explicitly; keys identify interface and address.

network.dns_servers.description: Resolver-file nameserver snapshot; not claimed to be complete ietf-system configured/effective DNS policy.

network.routes.description: Platform route rows; not falsely identified as complete ietf-routing RIB entries.

metrics.cpu_utilization_percent.description: Aggregate visible CPU busy-time delta; iowait treated as idle, guest columns are not added twice. Rounded to six decimal places; window recorded per probe.

metrics.disk_counters.description: Linux diskstats cumulative counters; raw counters, not rates. Linux sector counters are 512-byte sectors.

metrics.interface_counters.description: Linux net/dev cumulative counters; raw counters, not rates.

metrics.memory_pressure.description: Linux PSI some/full average stall percentages over 10/60/300 seconds and cumulative stall microseconds; missing PSI remains unavailable.

metrics.interfaces.in_octets.description: Cumulative counter, not a rate; use source times and reset/discontinuity evidence.

metrics.interfaces.out_octets.description: Cumulative counter, not a rate; use source times and reset/discontinuity evidence.

metrics.interfaces.in_errors.description: Cumulative counter, not a rate; use source times and reset/discontinuity evidence.

metrics.interfaces.out_errors.description: Cumulative counter, not a rate; use source times and reset/discontinuity evidence.

metrics.interfaces.in_discards.description: Cumulative counter, not a rate; use source times and reset/discontinuity evidence.

metrics.interfaces.out_discards.description: Cumulative counter, not a rate; use source times and reset/discontinuity evidence.

sensors.temperatures.description: Linux thermal-zone readings, Celsius; sensor inventory does not establish ietf-hardware component identity.

sensors.fans.description: Linux hwmon fan readings, RPM; unsupported sources remain explicit.

stdout.description: Original captured stdout, null when unavailable. UTF-8 byte bound enforced by semantic validator.

stderr.description: Original captured stderr, separated before any PTY stream merging.
